confound.description: The exact fallback was projected through the official head as [B,1,D], while the three residual slots were projected jointly as [B,3,D]. Tiny matrix-shape-dependent floating-point differences between otherwise bitwise-identical tokens were amplified by hard-max and rank metrics.

resolution: Project every slot through an identical contiguous [B,1,D] official-head call and require exact duplicate-slot descriptor parity in unit tests before repeating seed0.
